NOTE

DRAFT/OFF ONLY. Do not publish. Do not enroll contacts. Do not enable emails/SMS. External sends require approval:external-send-approved plus Jeff exact approval. Live CRM mutations require separate approval.

Source lane: Tech GC Launchpad / Colorado Tech Company Legal Health Checklist. Trigger tag: workflow:tech-gc-launchpad. Recommended fields: authority_pillar=Tech Outside General Counsel; lead_magnet=Colorado Tech Company Legal Health Checklist; recommended_offer=Tech Company OGC Launchpad; suggested_offer_lane=tech-gc; approval_status=pending; consent_basis=unknown pending review unless captured; pipeline_next_action=Map legal operating needs and decide whether OGC Launchpad review is appropriate.

Before any external action: confirm DND/unsubscribe/suppression, consent basis, approval status, absence of outreach:do-not-send, and presence of approval:external-send-approved. Imported/researched prospects remain internal-review-only.

Opportunity handling is recommendation-only: Find Opportunity in Whiteford Schell IP Pipeline before any create/update; no duplicate and no live stage movement without separate approval. If no existing opportunity, recommend New Lead stage only after approval.

Future email assets are placeholders only and must stay disabled/off unless separately approved: 69fae713e1364318517a1e97; wait 2 days; 69fae714e2f2ac3f34cea769; wait 3 days; 69fae715092f9ba066511737; wait 5 days; 69fae716b403f2fcddb84f89. No SMS, no social, no webhook/callout, no test send.

Legal/ethics guardrail: informational only; no legal advice; no attorney-client relationship; no confidential details before conflicts and engagement approval.
